title: feat(quests): daily rank movement and podium medals on the monthly leaderboard
author: Drjacky

gist.summary: The monthly Quest leaderboard now shows daily rank movement on each standings row: ↑ or ↓ with the number of places moved, “new” for someone who joined today, and no badge for an unchanged rank. The top three receive 🥇 🥈 🥉 instead of rank numbers. The /standings route calculates yesterday’s rank from Quest Pollen earned before today began in UTC, using the existing rewards ledger and the same exclusion and tie-break rules as today’s ranking; it adds no table, cron job, or snapshot. Medals and movement badges have accessible labels, and movement on the highlighted “You” row uses stronger-contrast text in dark mode. Standings still display GitHub logins and Quest Pollen totals; movement is a derived rank difference.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden, Polli wears a tiny referee cap and points to a lime green (#ecf874) monthly Quest leaderboard with three medal-topped flower pots and small up-and-down rank markers. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized within the scene, sharing the frame with other elements, never oversized or dominating the image, and strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with warm cream surroundings and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
